purpose: Run a fresh source-disjoint decision-grade development test of the mechanics-qualified labeled Semantic-IR treatment against direct generation, non-executing natural-language planning, and a prospective no-model compiler control, with completion-based generation and no project-selected answer-length cap.

selected_claim.causal_variable: Typed source-to-semantic-to-target lowering with stable obligation and semantic-scope AST identities, explicit loss or ambiguity, actual target validation, and dependency-local repair.

mechanics_change_from_terminal_P4R.semantic_unit_policy: Complete FunctionDef and AsyncFunctionDef nodes plus module/class Assign and AnnAssign nodes; nested statements and expression nodes are not treatment targets.
mechanics_change_from_terminal_P4R.first_call_prompt: Put information-matched request/context before a labeled output skeleton and require least-sufficient semantic-scope selection without exposing oracle targets.
mechanics_change_from_terminal_P4R.second_call_repair: Expose authentic visible-validator feedback and dependency closure, then require unrelated Semantic-IR units to remain byte-stable.
mechanics_change_from_terminal_P4R.parser: Independent labeled transport canonicalizes into the existing deterministic v1 lowerer.

post_source_selection_pre_candidate_repa.repair: Apply the maximum semantic-symbol-node bound after filtering the broad AST inventory to eligible complete semantic scopes. The prior order could discard later eligible scopes while returning fewer than the bound.
post_source_selection_pre_candidate_repa.maximum_inference: Pre-candidate instrument-adequacy repair only; no model, mechanism, D1, D2, serving, training, or book evidence.

matched_arm_contract.only_treatment_difference: The semantic arm must express edits through stable labeled semantic units that are independently parsed, identity-checked, dependency-checked, lowered, validated, and locality-audited.

budgets.maximum_generation_tokens_semantics: Legacy runner transport binding equal to the pinned model-declared context window; not a project-selected quality or answer-length cap. Exact prompt tokens are subtracted and normal completion occurs on a complete artifact or model EOS.

decision_rule.development_survivor: The treatment is useful on at least four of ten tasks, solves at least three more tasks than each learned control and the prospective no-model compiler control, loses head-to-head on no more than one task against either learned control, has zero unsafe or rollback failures, meets every mechanics and custody floor, and is not dominated on joined model-call, token, verifier, latency, or rollback cost.
decision_rule.adequate_no_survivor: Every adequacy requirement passes but the development-survivor rule does not. This exact bounded implementation is not advanced; no broader cognitive-compilation falsification follows.
decision_rule.inconclusive_implementation: Any treatment mechanics, parsing/lowering, intervention/locality, checkpoint-independent replay, or corruption floor fails.
decision_rule.inconclusive_experiment: Task diversity, matched resources, blind evaluation, source disjointness, uncertainty, weak-tail, or total-cost custody is incomplete.
decision_rule.uncertainty: Report all paired win/loss/tie tables, exact one-sided sign probabilities for non-tied treatment-versus-control outcomes, and task-level bootstrap intervals as descriptive development uncertainty; ten tasks cannot support a general population claim.
decision_rule.negative_scope: A null or loss applies only to this exact bounded Python labeled Semantic IR, frozen model, ten-task distribution, completion policy, validator, and repair policy. It cannot falsify cognitive compilation generally.

D1_rule.surface: one prospectively frozen fresh source-disjoint D1 qualification denominator

hosted_reference.future_extension: Use the same task membership and completion semantics with separately reported within-model denominators after a governed callable transport is source-bound.

maximum_inference: A terminal P4S result can decide only whether this exact mechanics-qualified labeled Semantic-IR implementation is a development survivor eligible for one fresh D1 qualification. It cannot establish general cognitive compilation, serving qualification, training eligibility, or ASI Stack book support.
